The test image shows a stem with a **tan-brown necrotic canker at a node junction** with shriveled dead tissue, on an otherwise partly-green stem. The Gray Mold stem reference was the closest visual match, showing a similar tan-brown lesion section on a green stem. Gray Mold (Botrytis) is well-known for infecting at node/wound sites, causing girdling stem cankers with this appearance. No visible gray spore mass, but that can be absent in dry conditions.
